exercises.title: Nothing is missing
exercises.body: An English apostrophe marks a letter that was dropped: do not loses its o and becomes don’t. Shavian never dropped anything — it writes the sounds you actually make, and you make every one of them. So don’t is simply 𐑛𐑴𐑯𐑑. No apostrophe, because nothing is missing.

exercises.title: The short ones
exercises.body: The same goes for the contractions that shrink a whole word: I’m is 𐑲𐑥, we’ll is 𐑢𐑰𐑤, it’s is 𐑦𐑑𐑕. Two letters each, and not a mark of punctuation among them. If you can say it, you can write it.

exercises.prompt: Why does Shavian have no apostrophe in 𐑛𐑴𐑯𐑑?
options: Because no sound is missing — it writes what you say
Because apostrophes are only for names
Because the naming dot replaces it
Because it is a short word
exercises.correct: Because no sound is missing — it writes what you say
